title: Egyptian Beef Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew from Egypt, made with tender beef brisket and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and turmeric

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef brisket on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add carrots and potatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
Add beef broth, spices, and browned beef. Bring to a boil.
Transfer to a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) and cook, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Stir in coconut milk and cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
